coverage_notes: Executed 12 targeted web searches across the four bounded recall classes: sole/last/full-service grocery loss; disaster-canceled emergency food distributions; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction; and official SNAP/WIC/EBT access interruption.
No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified within the bounded observation window.

Fresh surfaced material was non-qualifying or outside the window, including an October 5 Hawaiʻi report describing expanded emergency food distributions after prior storms rather than a newly canceled or suspended distribution, and an October 3 Hawaiʻi SNAP replacement-benefit notice tied to planned outages.
Other surfaced results were stale, routine expansion or program material, non-U.S., or did not establish immediate qualifying food-access loss.
Production collection remains authoritative; this supplementary recall watch did not approve, publish, alter the schedule, or disable the task.
